title: Auditor app hosted in Frappe with real officer login
scope: Build and serve the auditor app from the Frappe site (www/auditor, route rule, public assets) with real Frappe login for auditor, specialist and supervisor users and the live /api/v1 service; keep fixture mode only for local development

acceptance.text: Officers open /auditor on the Frappe site, are sent to login when signed out, see their real roles and tenant from get_access_scope, and can log out; the fixture role switcher and banner appear only in fixture mode
The auditor e2e suite passes against the live service for queue, case, evidence, review and management views; taxpayers are refused at /auditor and officers at /taxpayer
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

Verify session expiry, safe return navigation, logout and supported password recovery (configured mail or documented administrator-assisted local recovery); ordinary users cannot select roles or use administrator credentials.

verification: The auditor e2e suite passes against the live service for queue, case, evidence, review and management views; taxpayers are refused at /auditor and officers at /taxpayer

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05 after a runtime gap analysis for the RSL demo: the component code existed but this link was not wired at runtime and no task covered it.

notes: TAX-105 scope clarification: Make the complete Frappe login lifecycle explicit; native sessions remain separate initially.

notes.text: Reassigned from Kananelo to Keletso (single-developer delivery, ADR-038)
